evidence.title: Revone — All Your Revenue in One Place for macOS

name: Revone
summary: macOS app that unifies revenue from Stripe, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Paddle and other payment providers.
description: Native macOS app that connects 12 payment providers — Stripe, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Paddle, RevenueCat, Shopify and more — and shows orders, subscribers, a revenue calendar, top countries and menu bar stats in one dashboard. One-time purchase; API keys stay in the macOS Keychain.
contains: 12 payment provider integrations (Stripe, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Paddle, RevenueCat, Shopify …)
revenue calendar, orders timeline and subscriber overview
interactive 3D globe of purchase locations and top countries
macOS menu bar stats and widgets
per-provider setup docs; API keys stored in macOS Keychain
